Report 383-2026 - Growth - Development Services - Planning Services recommending approval of a zoning by-law amendment to allow for the renovation of the existing semi-detached dwelling to establish an office that would support the operations of the abutting Norwest Community Health Centre located at 525 Simpson Street.
WITH RESPECT to Report 383-2026-Growth-Development Services-Planning Services, we recommend that the Zoning By-law 1/2022 be amended on the subject lands, being Lots 35 and 36, Block 11, Plan W54, shown in Attachment A to Report 383-2026, and municipally known as 117 & 119 Heron Street, to re-zone the subject lands from “UL” – Urban Low-rise to “UX” – Urban Mixed Use;
AND THAT for the building existing on the 10
th
day of November 2026, a minimum of six parking spaces is required for an Office use;
AND THAT the property be designated as an area of Site Plan Control;
AND THAT any necessary by-laws be presented to City Council for ratification.
